name: NZ Transport Agency Waka Kotahi
story: NZTA and Eagle developed ArcGIS Enterprise on Kubernetes from 2021, with Peter Willoughby and Jithen Singh documented in the implementation case. A hub-and-spoke model combined centrally governed information with applications developed by business teams. The platform supported field surveys and situational awareness during Cyclone Gabrielle in February 2023.

The published customer case records field surveys and situational awareness during Cyclone Gabrielle. NZTA and Esri reported these benefits and performance figures; independent measurements are unavailable.

sources.label: Esri, 'NZTA Modernizes Highways with ArcGIS Enterprise on Kubernetes'
